messages.subject: AHMbook
parts:
Hi all,

I've have been trying to install the AHMbook and it keeps failing because the 'terra' package is not installed. I tried to then install the 'terra' package but that also fails. I'm running R v4.2.2 for Windows. Am I missing something obvious here on how to resolve this? Any help would be appreciated.

Tom A.

Well, here’s a ‘hit it and see’ response: I’ve often found that when Im missing dependencies and try and then install them in the same session as I tried to install the initial package, I get similar behavior. So, try starting a fresh R session, install terra, then install AHM.

 

HTH

Chris
